description:
[Calculators] Expected loot from a run of crates, barrels and NPCs. The loot simulator page's exact statistics (https://rust.wiki/calculators/loot-simulator): every item each
container can drop is rolled on its own chance, with an amount between the table's min and max. For the whole run,
each item gets `expected_amount` (average total), `chance_at_least_one` and `best_chance_per_container`;
`expected_item_stacks` is how many item stacks the run gives on average. Chances come from the game's loot tables
(the /loot-tables data). To actually open crates with the game's own loot roll (seeded, shareable, with exact
per-open chances), use /calculators/loot-simulator/open. Loot source names/ids come from list_loot_sources. To actually open crates with the game's own loot roll use simulate_crate_open.

limit.description: Most items to return (by expected amount).

run.description: Comma-separated `source:count` pairs - a loot source by id (from /loot-tables) or name - count defaults to 1, max 500 each.

search.description: Only items whose name contains this.

name: simulate_loot_run
title: Expected loot from a run of crates, barrels and NPCs
